summary: Iteration 123 - PMS Features: Digital Check-in, Invoice/Folio Management, Scheduled Reports. All 23 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI fully functional with tabbed detail panel (Info/Folio/Actions), folio management, and Scheduled Reports page verified.

endpoints: GET /api/guest-checkin/{booking_id} - Public endpoint returns booking info + registration status
POST /api/guest-checkin/{booking_id} - Public endpoint submits guest registration form
POST /api/guest-checkin/send-link/{booking_id} - Sends check-in link notification (auth required)
features: Public access for guest check-in form (no auth needed)
Returns booking details, property info, registration status
Accepts full registration data (name, passport, address, signature, terms)
Send check-in link creates notification log entry

endpoints: GET /api/folio/{booking_id} - Returns full folio with invoice_number, items, totals
POST /api/folio/{booking_id}/add-charge - Adds charge (minibar, room service, etc)
POST /api/folio/{booking_id}/add-payment - Records payment and updates payment_status
features: Auto-generates room charge on first folio access
Calculates totals: charges, payments, adjustments, balance_due
Supports multiple charge categories (minibar, room_service, laundry, spa, parking, damage)
Configurable sections (occupancy, revenue, arrivals, departures, housekeeping)
Report preview with real data (occupancy %, revenue, ADR, arrivals/departures count)

features_verified: Info tab shows guest details, dates, room info, summary
Folio tab shows invoice number, line items, totals
Actions tab shows status change buttons and Send Check-in Link
Line items with description, category, amount
Totals section with charges, payments, adjustments, balance_due
Add Charge form with description, amount, category dropdown
Record Full Payment button shows balance amount
Status change buttons (Check In, Check Out, Confirm, Cancel)
Buttons shown based on current booking status
Create Report form with name, frequency, time, recipients
KPI cards show occupancy %, revenue, arrivals, departures, housekeeping

critical_code_review_comments: Digital check-in GET endpoint is correctly public (no auth) for guest access
Folio auto-generates room charge on first access - good UX
Payment recording correctly updates booking payment_status based on balance
Scheduled reports preview returns real occupancy/revenue data from bookings
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Test folio items created: TEST_Minibar - Wine (£31.00), TEST_Partial payment (-£50.00), TEST_Loyalty discount (-£10.00)
